text:
nina: blocking onboarding for a customer. .NET SDK doesn't expose the bulk embeddings endpoint we use in the sample app. REST has POST /v1/embeddings:bulk but redwood-dotnet client only has Create for single input.

leo: can you paste the curl that worked and the C# that fails?

nina: curl that works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings:bulk \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"inputs\":[\"hello\",\"world\"]}'
```

nina: C# snippet (Redwood.Client v0.6.0):
```csharp
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(\"REDWOOD_KEY\"));
var r = await client.Embeddings.CreateAsync(new EmbeddingCreateRequest { Input = \"hello\" });
// no BulkAsync or Inputs property available
```

nina: workaround: I called REST from C# using HttpClient but that's yucky for the sample. Also saw odd retry behavior: when REST returns 202 (async queue) SDK treats it like success and never polls; conversely when REST returns 401 the SDK retries for ~20s before surfacing auth error.

sam: thanks. sounds like three issues: missing binding for embeddings:bulk, param name drift (inputs vs input), and retry/polling logic for async status codes and auth.

leo: digging in generator logs: the openapi operationId for bulk is embeddings.bulkCreate and path has a colon (embeddings:bulk). our dotnet generator skips paths with colons by default. similar to other SDKs we missed.

sam: for the 202 case, server now returns 202 with Location header for queued jobs; SDK should detect 202 and either return a ticket object or follow the Location header until 200. It currently treats anything non-2xx as error except 202 was accidentally treated as 200 because of a content-length check bug.

nina: and the auth retries? customer used a user-scoped key missing embeddings:write scope and we saw retries. A quick log: SDK did 6 retries with no exponential backoff.

ci-bot: test redwood-dotnet/tests/integration/embeddings_bulk_test.cs failed on main.

leo: plan: (A) flip generator config to include colon paths for dotnet and add explicit allow-list for public bulk endpoints, (B) add Embeddings.BulkAsync(List<string> inputs) binding and map inputs -> inputs JSON key, (C) implement 202 polling or return a JobHandle object with PollAsync, (D) fix retry policy: do not retry on 401/403, cap retries to 4 with exponential backoff + jitter, add quick-fail for auth scopes.

sam: I'll own (B)/(C) and the unit tests. I'll also add an integration that hits staging to ensure polling works with Location header.

leo: I'll own (A) in generator and add operation alias mapping so colon ops are converted to valid method names (e.g., EmbeddingsBulkAsync).

nina: timeline? customer demo in ~6 hours. sample-dotnet must show bulk embed working or they won't proceed.

sam: I'll push a small hotfix that manually adds BulkAsync to the client wrapper in sample app repo so we can demo, and open a PR to sdk repo for the proper generator fix. sample patch: https://github.com/redwood/sample-dotnet-onboard/commit/2b7e9c

ci-bot: created issue RNF-2899 in redwood-dotnet: "embeddings:bulk binding + 202 polling + retry fixes".

leo: QA notes: add tests for both immediate 200 bulk response and 202+Location queue response; assert polling respects Location and timeouts after 60s; add negative test with expired token to assert immediate 401 and no retries.

nina: confirmed sample-app workaround with HttpClient works for the customer; demo scheduled and they are OK with temporary helper. I'll update onboarding docs to mention the workaround.

sam: PR opened in redwood-dotnet: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-dotnet/pull/44 with BulkAsync + polling + retry changes. Requesting a patch release v0.6.1.

leo: regenerated generator on staging, added alias rules, and ran smoke tests. awaiting review on PR.

devx-bot: release note draft: "Fix: .NET SDK: add embeddings:bulk binding, support 202 queue polling, and tighten retry policy to avoid auth tight-loops." scheduled for v0.6.1.

nina: thanks team. will validate v0.6.1-rc and remove helper from sample app once released.

ci-bot: CI green on patched branch.

sam: patch released as v0.6.1-rc.1 to our private feed.

nina: confirmed v0.6.1-rc.1 BulkAsync works and polling returns job result. customer demo successful. closing the onboarding ticket. :tada:

devx-bot: thread archived.
